{{Otheruses|Battle of New Plympto}}
The '''Ash Ruination of New Plympto''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] victory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The triumph was credited to Imperial [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|incinerator stormtroopers]], and were reputed to have won the battle solely with thermobaric canisters and mortar launchers.<ref name="handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
